evidence.notes: SOSL Search.query accepts boolean WITH SPELL_CORRECTION and keeps deterministic Test.setFixedSearchResults rows without local spell-correction ranking.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSOSLWithSpellCorrectionTest { @isTest static void acceptsSpellCorrectionSearchOption() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'San Francisco Supply'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ account.Id }); List<Account> rows = (List<Account>)Search.query('FIND {San Francisco} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) WITH SPELL_CORRECTION = false')[0]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(account.Id, rows[0].Id); System.assertEquals('San Francisco Supply', rows[0].Name); Boolean invalidRejected = false; try { Search.query('FIND {San Francisco} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) WITH SPELL_CORRECTION = maybe'); } catch (Exception e) { invalidRejected = true; } System.assert(invalidRejected); } }
